adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, which does `usernames = params.require(:usernames)` and then iterates `usernames.split(",").each` with no cap or validation on length/count. That allows a single request to attempt adding an arbitrarily large number of usernames, resulting in potentially very long processing time and heavy DB work (looping `User.find_by_username` + `group.add(user)` many times) before `group.save`, creating a realistic performance/DoS risk within an admin session.
